chunks: Muʿāwiyah ibn ʿAmmār narrated from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:

I asked him about a man who died and made a bequest that hajj be performed on his behalf. He said: “If he was a ṣarūrah, hajj is to be performed on his behalf from the middle of the wealth; and if he was not a ṣarūrah, then from one-third.”

key_terms.أَوْصَى: made a bequest or final instruction
key_terms.صَرُورَةً: a person who has not yet performed hajj
key_terms.وَسَطِ الْمَالِ: from the main body of the estate
key_terms.يُحَجَّ: that hajj be performed on his behalf

ai.seo_question: If someone dies after bequeathing hajj on his behalf, is it paid from the whole estate or only from one-third?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about a deceased person's bequest for hajj on his behalf. If the deceased had never performed the obligatory hajj, the cost is taken from the estate as a primary obligation; if he had already performed hajj, then fulfilling the bequest comes from one-third of the estate.
